name: Veil of Veils
source: Inner Sea Gods pg. 271, Gods and Magic pg. 60
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 271, Gods and Magic pg. 60
Aura faint illusion; CL 3rd
Slot head; Price 3,300 gp; Weight —
Description
This fine silken veil can change color or alter its appearance to a highwayman’s mask or similar cloth face covering. Once per day, the wearer can use disguise self, though the veil remains visible as some kind of garment on the wearer’s head or face.

If Sivanah is the wearer’s patron, once per day the wearer can use blur. In addition, the wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Bluff checks.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, blur, disguise self, creator must have 5 ranks in Bluff; Cost 1,650 gp
